identification: Late Victorian/Edwardian style farmhouse kitchen table: scrubbed pine plank top with rounded corners on a black-painted apron and four ring-turned tapering legs. Base paint is crazed/flaking (alligatored black paint), so the 'blackwood' in the title cannot be confirmed from photos. A separate loose two-plank pine extension board (rough, weathered, splits, stains) sits on one end to make up the 194 cm; the table itself is roughly 150-160 cm. No drawer clearly visible (only a small square notch in the apron). Ordinary Tasmanian farmhouse table, not a premium colonial piece. Estimate 200-250, current bid $100.
